title: OccludeBench: Can VLMs Find What's Missing?
abstract: How well can vision-language models (VLMs) reason about what is missing from an image? We study this question with OccludeBench, a manually curated benchmark for recovering fully occluded objects from the visual evidence that remains. OccludeBench distinguishes direct cases, where the hidden object must be recovered from a specific physical cue such as a shadow or reflection, from inferential cases, where it can be inferred from broader scene context. Across five VLMs, accuracy averages 42.7% on direct cases versus 62.7% on inferential cases, exhibiting a 20.0-point gap. Humans attain higher accuracies of 63.4% versus 68.5% for direct and inferential images, respectively, with no significant gap. To locate this failure, we introduce OccludeTrace, a four-stage diagnostic that isolates where the visual reasoning process breaks down. The bottleneck emerges when models must recover the relevant object from the projection within the full image: they succeed on only 50% of failed examples, compared with 91% of examples they answer correctly. Extended reasoning, tool use, and few-shot prompting yield inconsistent improvements and do not reliably eliminate the gap. In contrast, an inpaint-then-confront intervention, which prompts models to first generate a candidate hidden object and then evaluate that hypothesis against the visible physical cue, reduces the gap to a statistically non-significant difference for both models with image-generation capabilities. Together, our results establish a tractable, controlled diagnostic for isolating how VLMs reason about visual content that is missing from an image.

analysis.sourceNote: 依据 exact version 2610.13790v1 的 23 页全文与关键图表核验整理。实验数字与比较均为作者报告，本项目未独立复现。
analysis.ideaZh: OccludeBench 区分凭shadow/reflection找完全遮挡物体与context推断，并用4阶段OccludeTrace定位fullimage中的cue extraction弱点。其inpaint→confront原型让GPT/Gemini先具象化候选再检查physicalcue，作者报告direct各+16.7/+10.6pp；残余8.1/5.6pp只是未达显著，不证明gap已消失。可skim借鉴生成假设辅助视觉推理，仍是小controlledtask的诊断与原型。
analysis.motivationZh: 物体被完全遮住后，VLM 需要依赖 shadow、reflection、context 等可见证据推断缺失对象，普通 recognition benchmark 难检验这种能力。还需要区分模型有没有读到线索，与能否把线索映射到正确物体。
analysis.methodZh: 378真实图片人工遮住目标，197direct物理projection cues、181inferentialcontext，5VLM与473human自由回答比较；correctness为Claude/GPT任一judge接受。OccludeTrace分别cue yes/no、croprecognition、four-region sourcemapping、highlightedfullimage description，按原始成功/失败分组发现最后阶段差大。扩大reasoning/tools/fewshot/steer收益不稳定；两具imagegeneration能力的models先inpaintmask，再freshcall看original+infill并质疑reflection/shadow一致性，修正答案。贡献不仅benchmark，还有可执行generative hypothesis-testing prototype，但没有新模型训练，也未在一般design/spatialtasks验证。
methodFlow: 人工收集与遮挡真实images，保留projection或contextcue，并经annotatorunanimous筛选direct/inferentialcategories。
针对directcase用nativeimagegeneration inpaint occludedregion，要求其余pixels保持，生成一个候选hiddenobject。
freshVLMcall并排看maskedoriginal与infill，检查shadow/reflectionphysicalcompatibility，再重新自由回答并用同judgingrule评分。
analysis.experimentsZh: 378人工maskimages：353Internet、19VG、6authors；5VLM including GPT5.4/Gemini3.1Pro/Claude4.6/Qwen3VL8B/Llama4。473Prolificparticipants各6questions，direct/infer各3且randomorder。two-judgeORanswerlabels，作者报告98%goldagreement。reasoning、5roundbasictools、2heldoutfewshot、promptsteers与2-modelimagegenerationprototype；temperature0，单fixedpipeline无重复generationCI。 以下结果为作者报告：作者报告5VLM平均direct42.7%/infer62.7%，human63.4/68.5，per-imageMannU p.079；nonsignificanthuman差不等同严格同难度。（Table1/ Sec.3.1 PDF p.4; AppendixD PDF pp.20–21）；作者报告GPT5.4 direct37.6→54.3、Gemini71.6→82.2，inferbaselines保持62.4/87.8，剩余gap8.1/5.6pp p.12/.15。（Table3, PDF p.8）；作者报告OccludeTrace failed/successful cue99/100、crop79/88、source85/82、fullimage50/91%；phaseprompts改变input/localization信息，不应视为纯causalmechanism。（Table2, PDF p.6）；作者报告GPTthinking+longsteer direct51.8→69.2，比inpaintbase54.3更高，但对应inferreasoningbudget不同，所有干预不能只比较gap。（Sec.3.3, PDF p.7） 对照范围：有5base、highreasoning、generictool/codingharness、steer与fewshot，提供多种失败背景；inpaint仅2imagegeneratingmodels，同familygenerationvariant和额外prompt未用matchedbudget/shamcontrol分离。 消融与诊断：unmaskedboxaccuracy高、mask颜色改动与lexical/category/humandifficulty检查支持controlledsetting，但direct/infer非pairedimages，作者所谓排除confounds不可当全部causal排除。cuecategoriesGPTdirectp.0037显著，其他NS不证明完全一致；inpainting效果缺loopiterations/generator preservation量化。
analysis.insightZh: controlleddirect-vs-contextmissingobjectbenchmark与stage诊断提供精细的visualevidence-use观察；inpaintthenconfront把generation作为外显hypothesis以供visualreasoning核验。方法是prototypeprompt/toolprocedure，非新foundationmodel、训好prior或证明generalamodalphysicalreasoning。
analysis.evidenceZh: 人工mask让cue/category可控，但自然occlusion并未测，categories对应不同images。（Sec.2.1, Fig.3, PDF p.3）；stage4在basefailed/successfulgroup差50%vs91%，是diagnosticassociation而非causalrule-out。（Table2 and Sec.3.2, PDF pp.5–6）；inpainting需要nativegeneration和第二freshcall观察两个images，新增提示/调用与生成作用未分离。（Sec.3.3, Table3/Fig.9, PDF pp.7–9; AppendixA.8, PDF pp.18–19）；剩余gap统计不显著不等同equivalence或完全闭合。（Table3, PDF p.8）
analysis.caveatZh: dataset378人工curatedrealimages，作者指出小source组6/19的accuracy noisy。；不自然occlusion；自然projection可能失真/缺失，benchmark刻意保留可判cue。；case工具/推理/少样本不一致，inpaintprototype依赖imagegeneration能力。；judgeORrule接受任一模型意见可能inflate，98%authoragreement需独立审计；评估models兼作judges仍有潜在sharedbias。；从group分解和NS难度推断唯一bottleneck过强；stageformat差异与lowpower/p>.05不能证明等价。；inpainting可能改visiblecues且没有quantpreservationcontrol，新增reflectionsteer本身可能解释部分收益。；prototype值得追踪generativevisualhypothesis，但数据小、真实遮挡/generalspatial/design迁移未测，数字未复现。
analysis.whyRelevantZh: 围绕physicalprojectioncue与hiddencontent推理，生成显式假设再检查证据可启发VLM视觉设计/3D状态判断，但当前未提供设计artifact或geometryaccuracy验证。
